name: Layer AI
tagline: AI production platform for game creative, ads, and live-ops assets.
description: Layer is an AI production platform that helps game studios scale creative output — user-acquisition ads, live-ops content, and marketing assets — across image, video, 3D, and audio, with custom style training for on-brand results. It supports batch generation of 500+ variants per day and integrates with Photoshop, Blender, Maya, Unreal, Unity, and Figma. It is used by 300+ entertainment brands including Zynga, King, and SciPlay.
insight: Raised a $6.5M seed in May 2025 led by Arcadia, with ties to King co-founder Riccardo Zacconi; founded 2023 by ex-Unity veterans.
edge: Optimized for live-ops and UA creative throughput with deep DCC-tool integration, not one-off asset generation.
